other_conditions: Applicant must be a Non‑Resident Indian (NRI), Person of Indian Origin (PIO) or Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) currently working abroad.
Applicant must hold a Ph.D., M.D., M.S. or M.Tech degree from a recognized university.
Applicant must be engaged in active research.

Applicant must have worked for at least 5 years in an Institute/University that is ranked in the top‑200 of the QS World University Ranking (subject‑wise) in a regular/tenure position, or at least 5 years in a reputable foreign industry or research laboratory (cannot be a Ph.D. or post‑doctoral fellow).

Host Indian institution must be a Higher Educational Institution/University ranked in the top 200 in NIRF overall rankings or have NAAC ‘A+’ grade or above, or be a public‑funded scientific institute/national laboratory.
A consent letter from the Head of the Host Institute is mandatory.
Application must be submitted online through the DST e‑PMS portal after registering with an active e‑mail ID.
benefits_summary: The fellowship provides up to ₹4,00,000 per month for a maximum of 2 months per year, along with travel, accommodation, and a research grant of up to ₹5 Lakhs per year for a period of up to 3 years.
documents_required: Consent letter from the Head of the Host Institute
